title: E-FRC-0107: no schedule of line couples can keep the triality that selects a color plane and also connect all twelve...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0107 in the gauge arena: no schedule of line couples can keep the triality that selects a color plane and also connect all twelve lines, under the CPT the committed rule was adopted with: triality fixes the three color-plane lines, none of the 10,395 ways to couple all twelve lines is invariant, CPT with a parity that commutes with triality forces every beat to be invariant, and an invariant beat never couples a color line to another, so joining them symmetrically needs a four-line block.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
